name: Bridie Maguire, Queen of the Erne

intro.text: {greeting} I'm Bridie Maguire. My family ruled these lakes from a castle with a water gate, six hundred years ago. These days I just rule the regatta.
Every keeper who comes through Enniskillen wants to test themselves against the Queen of the Erne. Come on, then. Mind the swans.

win: Well. The Erne has a new favourite. Don't let it go to your head, there's not much room under the bridges.
after: Come back any time and I'll take you out on the lough. Upper Lough Erne for the quiet, Lower for the wind. Both for the rain.
